category: Content Duplication & Canonical Mismatch
root_cause: Both routes render identical ApplianceHomePage component with ssr:false, creating duplicate content and splitting search equity.
evidence: Direct code inspection: ApplianceHomePage component rendered in both routes
recommended_fix: Apply 301 permanent redirect from /appliance-repair-services to /appliances or set canonical to /appliances.

category: Client-Side Only Redirects on Legacy Routes
root_cause: Routes use useEffect() router.replace() instead of server-side permanent redirects. Search crawlers receive HTTP 200 with empty body instead of HTTP 301/308.
evidence: Lines 10 in both files: useEffect(() => router.replace(...), [])
recommended_fix: Implement Next.js permanent redirects in next.config.js or route.js server handler.

category: Cross-Canonical Sitemap Inconsistency
root_cause: sitemapManager.js includes /blog in sitemap, but app/blog/page.js exports canonical tag pointing to /knowledge. GSC flags as Submitted URL not selected as canonical.
evidence: sitemapManager.js line 24 vs blog/page.js re-exporting knowledge canonical
recommended_fix: Align sitemap by removing /blog or adding permanent 301 redirect from /blog to /knowledge.

category: Dual CMS URL Duplication (Help Center vs Knowledge Base)
root_cause: Both routes fetch from same /knowledge-base API and serve identical article text under competing canonical URLs.
evidence: API call in knowledge/[slug] vs help-center/[categorySlug]/[articleSlug]
recommended_fix: Consolidate single canonical URL authority: make Help Center the definitive home for user guides and 301 redirect legacy /knowledge/[slug] URLs.

category: Client-Side Rendering (CSR) Loading Spinner on Dynamic City Landing Pages
root_cause: Components use use client with initial loading=true state. Initial SSR HTML contains only loading spinner (<Loader2>), delaying schema and heading discovery.
evidence: Line 14 in page.js: if (loading) return <Loader2 />
recommended_fix: Refactor data fetching to Next.js Server Components with generateMetadata() and pre-rendered server HTML.

category: Inconsistent Flat vs Nested Canonical Injections in Structured Data
root_cause: canonicalManager.js defines flat canonical (/ac-repair-service-center-hyderabad), but schemaData in repair-service/[citySlug]/page.js injects nested legacy URLs into hasOfferCatalog.
evidence: Line 390 in page.js: url: .../appliances/repair-service/${citySlug}/${cat.slug}
recommended_fix: Update schema generator to use buildCanonicalUrl(CATEGORY_CITY) ensuring 100% canonical consistency.

category: Viewport Zoom Disabled on Mobile Devices
root_cause: app/layout.js exports userScalable: false and maximumScale: 1, violating WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines and Google Mobile-Friendly standards.
evidence: Lines 73-77 in app/layout.js: userScalable: false, maximumScale: 1
recommended_fix: Update viewport export: set width: device-width, initialScale: 1 and remove maximumScale/userScalable restrictions.

category: Spelling Errors in Root Metadata Description
root_cause: Root layout description contains spelling errors: Spa & Saloon instead of Spa & Salon, and Sytem instead of System, appearing in Google SERP snippets.
evidence: Line 38 in app/layout.js: ...PG & Hostel Booking Sytem Lifestyle and Religious services...
recommended_fix: Correct typos in app/layout.js: replace Saloon with Salon and Sytem with System.

category: Missing Dynamic generateMetadata() on Critical Vertical Route Templates
root_cause: Templates are use client components without generateMetadata(), causing all dynamic child views to inherit generic root layout metadata.
evidence: No export async function generateMetadata in 28 dynamic page.js files
recommended_fix: Extract metadata generation into server page.js files and pass resolved data to client components.

category: High-Value Public Landing Pages Omitted from XML Sitemap
root_cause: Important public entry points are omitted from STATIC_ROUTES in sitemapManager.js, reducing crawl discovery frequency.
evidence: Array inspection of STATIC_ROUTES in sitemapManager.js
recommended_fix: Add approved public landing pages to STATIC_ROUTES in sitemapManager.js with priority 0.8–0.9.

category: Thin Content & Soft-404 Risk on Combinatorial City-Brand Pages
root_cause: 962 combinatorial city-brand pages are generated programmatically in sitemap regardless of whether active technicians exist for that brand in that city.
evidence: sitemapInventory.js loops all cities * all brands (26 * 37 = 962)
recommended_fix: Add technician/service verification filter in sitemapInventory.js before emitting city-brand URLs; return 404 or noindex for empty listings.

category: Conditional Server-Side Homepage Redirect Vulnerability
root_cause: app/(landing)/page.jsx conditionally redirects homepage to /appliance-repair-services if API returns homescreen:false, creating an unexpected redirect chain.
evidence: Lines 36-38 in app/(landing)/page.jsx: if (!showHomeScreen) redirect(/appliance-repair-services)
recommended_fix: Hardcode homepage stability or fallback gracefully without redirecting the apex root domain.

category: Dynamic XML Sitemaps Missing Persistent lastmod Timestamps
root_cause: sitemapInventory.js uses new Date() fallback when entity updatedAt is missing, causing lastmod to change on every request and preventing cache efficiency.
evidence: sitemapInventory.js lines 240, 260, 290: lastModified: ... || new Date()
recommended_fix: Store and query actual entity updated timestamps from MongoDB; emit consistent lastmod dates.

category: Synchronous params.slug Access in Next.js 16 Component
root_cause: In app/knowledge/[slug]/page.js, params.slug is accessed synchronously inside KnowledgeArticle component instead of awaiting params promise.
evidence: Line 145 in page.js: https://doorstephub.com/knowledge/${params.slug}
recommended_fix: Await params before accessing params.slug in component body.

category: Missing BreadcrumbList Structured Data on Category & Subcategory Pages
root_cause: Category and listing pages render breadcrumbs visually but do not emit Schema.org BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, missing Google rich snippet breadcrumbs.
evidence: Absence of application/ld+json BreadcrumbList in CategoryPage.jsx
recommended_fix: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD component to CategoryPage and ServicesListingPage.

category: Missing LocalBusiness Coordinates & Hours on City Hubs
root_cause: City landing pages emit Service schema instead of LocalBusiness / HomeAndConstructionBusiness with geo coordinates, openingHours, and telephone.
evidence: Line 385: @type: Service without geo or address coordinates
recommended_fix: Upgrade schema to LocalBusiness with proper addressCountry, addressLocality, postalCode, and geo coordinates.

category: Uncanonicalized Query Parameters on Search & Filter Results
root_cause: Filter and search routes lack canonical tag pointing back to parent clean listing URL, creating infinite crawlable URL variations.
evidence: No canonical alternate in metadata of results layouts
recommended_fix: Add canonical pointing to primary category/listing root and ensure meta robots is set to noindex, follow on filtered query strings.

category: Redundant Duplicate Route Tree (/services/* vs /appliances/*)
root_cause: /services/* sub-routes mirror /appliances/* sub-routes, causing duplicate maintenance and internal confusion.
evidence: File tree structure under app/services vs app/appliances
recommended_fix: Consolidate public navigation onto /appliances and redirect /services/* legacy paths.

category: Social Preview Image Aspect Ratio Inconsistency on Dynamic Articles
root_cause: Some article preview images lack explicit 1200x630 dimension tags, causing WhatsApp/Twitter to crop previews improperly.
evidence: Line 660 in app/lib/seo.js: finalImageObj dimension fallbacks
recommended_fix: Enforce width: 1200, height: 630 on all Open Graph image exports.

category: Heading Hierarchy Skipped on Dynamic Loading States
root_cause: Because initial render is a loading spinner, search engine initial snapshot sees zero <h1> tags on city landing pages.
evidence: Loader2 returned before <h1> is mounted in DOM
recommended_fix: Refactor to Next.js Server Components with streaming Suspense so <h1> is present in initial server HTML payload.
